me.name: Aqsa Zamzami
me.tagline: Building reliable backend architectures and fast, tactile web and mobile interfaces.
bio: I am a software engineer based in Indonesia. I spend my time digging into how software works under the hood, from raw socket streaming and database internals up to fluid 60fps UI engineering.
I focus on building resilient backend services and clean, responsive user interfaces. I believe good engineering should be transparent, fast, and satisfying to use.

projects.title: PRIME
projects.desc: An industrial predictive maintenance monorepo designed to process real-time machine telemetry, forecast failure risks before breakdowns happen, and provide semantic search across technical documentation.
projects.context: An exploration into distributed architecture. The main challenge was coordinating five services: handling sensor ingestion in Express alongside Python ML prediction tasks, while caching vector search results in Redis so queries stayed under 50ms.
projects.contribution: Architected the microservices monorepo setup, configured multi-container Docker compose environments, integrated TimescaleDB for time-series data, and developed the Next.js analytical UI.
projects.highlight: Monorepo with TimescaleDB + Qdrant Vector Retrieval

projects.title: Ardana
projects.desc: A financial administration and cooperative ledger platform handling member savings, loan disbursements, and automated interest installment calculations.
projects.context: Built using Laravel 12, Inertia.js (React 19), and Tailwind CSS v4. Financial systems cannot tolerate calculation discrepancies, so enforcing strict database transaction locks and consistency in PostgreSQL was the central focus.
projects.contribution: Engineered the database schema with transactional rollback safety in PostgreSQL, built the reactive client with Inertia.js React, and designed clean accounting ledger dashboards.
projects.highlight: Laravel 12 + Inertia (React 19) with strict transactional accounting

projects.title: ShareThem
projects.desc: A lightweight mobile application for peer-to-peer file transfer over local Wi-Fi without requiring an internet connection or account setup.
projects.context: Built to avoid commercial file-sharing apps that are bloated with ads and complex connection steps. It scans the local subnet via mDNS and streams byte chunks over raw TCP sockets at full local Wi-Fi speeds.
projects.contribution: Implemented zero-config service discovery using the Bonsoir mDNS plugin, built chunked TCP/UDP socket streaming handlers in Dart, and created an intuitive mobile transfer UI.
projects.highlight: Zero-config mDNS discovery & raw socket streaming in Flutter

projects.title: Expasign
projects.desc: An event and competition registration platform that automates ticket allocation and payment verification using Saweria webhook callbacks.
projects.context: Created to eliminate long manual bank transfer verification queues during a campus competition. The webhook receiver verifies signatures and updates participant payment status in under 3 seconds.
projects.contribution: Built the event registration pipeline, configured automated Saweria webhook listeners with state reconciliation, and designed the ticket QR verification workflow.
projects.highlight: Automated payment verification pipeline with Saweria Webhooks

projects.title: InvenSync
projects.desc: A retail Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management web app powered by Oracle Database 21c.
projects.context: A practical dive into enterprise relational databases. Moving beyond standard MySQL meant working with Oracle 21c PL/SQL sequences, automated trigger-based stock audits, and multi-table transactions in an MVC structure.
projects.contribution: Modeled the relational database schema, wrote native PL/SQL triggers for automated inventory auditing, and built the cashier checkout and reporting interfaces.
projects.highlight: Built on Oracle Database 21c with PL/SQL Triggers & Sequences

projects.title: PickyNet
projects.desc: A decision support system that evaluates and ranks Internet Service Providers using the WASPAS multi-criteria mathematical model.
projects.context: An academic team project created to objectively compare ISP options for boarding houses and student housing. The core work involved translating WSM and WPM matrix formulas into real-time ranking calculations in Laravel.
projects.contribution: Programmed the core WASPAS normalization and lambda matrix weighting engine in Laravel 12, structured dynamic criteria parameter inputs, and co-designed the comparative result screens.
projects.highlight: Algorithmic decision modeling via WASPAS (WSM + WPM)

points: Architected distributed and reactive web applications including PRIME (predictive maintenance monorepo) and Ardana (cooperative finance).
Researched and integrated modern data layers: TimescaleDB for time-series telemetry, Qdrant for vector search, and Redis for caching.
Engineered enterprise-grade retail inventory POS systems (InvenSync) using Oracle Database 21c triggers, sequences, and procedures.
Developed automated webhook payment verification pipelines for campus competition portals (Expasign), eliminating manual confirmation queues.
Built zero-configuration local peer-to-peer file transfer systems using Flutter and raw TCP socket streaming (ShareThem).
Implemented algorithmic Decision Support Systems implementing WASPAS multi-criteria matrix mathematics (PickyNet).
